entries.en: Tonaxia is beside herself in giggling glee.
entries.fr: Tonaxia réfléchit visiblement à sa prochaine farce.
entries.ja: シルフの仮宿のトナクシアは、新しいイタズラのネタを思いついたようだ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Despite her attempts to play innocent, it is evident that Tonaxia is in need of ingredients for her latest prank. Strike out for Larkscall; slay a morbol, an old-growth treant, and two molted ziz; and harvest the malodorous items she seeks─a phial of morbol bile, a rotting acorn, and two phials of ziz venom, respectively.

entries.en: The unpleasant creatures are no more, and their unpleasant remains are yours. Deliver the aforementioned goods to Tonaxia.
entries.fr: Vous avez obtenu les objets dont Tonaxia a besoin. Portez-les-lui au Refuge avant que leur odeur n'imprègne vos vêtements.

entries.en: Tonaxia is pleased to receive the items she requested, and promises that you will not be the victim of her foul-smelling plot─provided, of course, you continue to do her bidding.
entries.fr: Vous avez remis avec soulagement les produits pestilentiels demandés par Tonaxia. La victime de son prochain canular est pro<->ba<->ble<->ment à plaindre...
entries.ja: トナクシアに依頼品を渡した。イタズラの材料を手に入れたトナクシアは、とても喜んでいるようだ。冒険者は仕事ぶりを褒められ、また手伝ってほしいと頼まれてしまった。

entries.en: This might be this one's most ingenious trick ever! This one cannot wait to see walking one's face when this one─oh?
entries.fr:
Hi hi hi, j'ai trouvé la farce idéale,
ce sera un véritable régal!
Pour rire, quoi de mieux qu'une exquise puanteur,
quoi de plus drôle qu'une abjecte odeur?

新しいイタズラを、思いついちゃったのでふっち！
くさ～い魔物のくさ～いニオイを使って……はッ！？

その代わり、わたぴのお手伝いをするのでふっち！
